title: Unit 30 Consolidation: Geopolitics, East and West
goal: I can use the words of geopolitics, regional history and alliances.
I can use scalar adverbs, participles before a noun, balanced contrast and purpose clauses.
I can present a disputed question with each view under its own *szerint*.
